caption: MCP Tool Output Schema
description:
An optional JSON Schema object defining the structure of the tool's output returned in
the structuredContent field of a CallToolResult.

Defaults to JSON Schema 2020-12 when no explicit $schema is provided.
Currently restricted to type: "object" at the root level. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 Tool.outputSchema; 2026-07-28 Tool.outputSchema).
name: mcp_tool__output_schema
